name: strudel-desktop
description: Lokale Desktop-Version von Strudel mit Sample-Browser, Templates und Projektverwaltung

scripts.test: vite build && STRUDEL_TEST=tests/smoke.cjs STRUDEL_USER_DATA=$(mktemp -d) STRUDEL_LIBRARY=$(mktemp -d)/a/b/projects electron . --ozone-platform=headless --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader
scripts.test:assist: vite build && STRUDEL_TEST=tests/assist.cjs STRUDEL_USER_DATA=$(mktemp -d) STRUDEL_LIBRARY=$(mktemp -d)/a/b/projects electron . --ozone-platform=headless --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader
scripts.test:assist-live: vite build && STRUDEL_TEST=tests/assist-live.cjs STRUDEL_USER_DATA=$(mktemp -d) STRUDEL_LIBRARY=$(mktemp -d)/a/b/projects electron . --ozone-platform=headless --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader
scripts.test:offline: vite build && STRUDEL_TEST=tests/offline.cjs STRUDEL_USER_DATA=$(mktemp -d) STRUDEL_LIBRARY=$(mktemp -d)/a/b/projects electron . --ozone-platform=headless --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader --host-resolver-rules='MAP * ~NOTFOUND'
